Specification: This module specifies a graph-based message-passing algorithm that computes parent pointers and depths from a distinguished root over an undirected graph, together with recursive definitions of graph reachability used to justify the network structure. The assumptions require that every edge connects exactly two nodes, that the root is a node, that MaxNodes bounds the number of nodes, and that every node is reachable from the root. The PlusCal algorithm PathsToRoot is translated into TLA+ with variables msgs, depth, and parent; the temporal specification asserts initialization, step behavior, and weak fairness for each node process.
AssumptionNames:
/\ \A e \in Edges : (e \subseteq Nodes) /\ HasTwoElts(e)
       /\ root \in Nodes
       /\ MaxNodes >= Cardinality(Nodes)

IF B = {} THEN T ELSE RF(SetNbrs(B) \ T, B \cup T)
IF self = root THEN 0 ELSE MaxNodes

IF d < depth[self] - 1 THEN /\ depth' = [depth EXCEPT ![self] = d + 1] /\ parent' = [parent EXCEPT ![self] = q[1]] /\ msgs' = [r \in Queues |-> IF r = q THEN msgs[r] \ {d} ELSE IF r \in QueuesFrom(self) \ {<<self, q[1]>>} THEN msgs[r] \cup {depth'[self]} ELSE msgs[r]] ELSE /\ msgs' = [msgs EXCEPT ![q] = msgs[q] \ {d}] /\ UNCHANGED << depth, parent >>
IF r = q THEN msgs[r] \ {d} ELSE IF r \in QueuesFrom(self) \ {<<self, q[1]>>} THEN msgs[r] \cup {depth'[self]} ELSE msgs[r]
IF r \in QueuesFrom(self) \ {<<self, q[1]>>} THEN msgs[r] \cup {depth'[self]} ELSE msgs[r]
